name: IC Driver — 100V — SOIC
description: A cluster of 8 surface-mount 100V IC driver parts in SOIC package footprints including standard SOIC-8 and exposed-pad SOIC-8-1EP variants.
selection_hints: Choose when requiring a 100V IC driver in an SMD SOIC package.
Select between standard SOIC-8 and thermal exposed-pad SOIC-8-1EP footprints based on PCB layout requirements.
Prefer Tier A parts, which comprise 6 of the 8 available cluster entries.
avoid_when: Avoid if the circuit requires a non-100V rated driver.
Avoid when packages other than SOIC or non-SMD mountings are needed.
Avoid if footprint land pattern requirements do not match SOIC-8 pitch or body dimensions.
